main_text.head: [iro] longè Illustri [Domino] Thomæ Overbury, Equiti Aurato.
main_text.p: [D]Vanquam, jam totos [hos] viginti annos, [&] quod excurrit, [ci]ta noftra variis ftudiis [&] [...] ordinis viris accepta [...]; nemo tamen extitit nisi [...] aut alter, qui medius [...]usque partibus, & citra [...]amorem, aut odium, sen[ten]tiam meam, amicis cele[bris] [...]ris nominis in Ecclesia, [...]riis, nec induktis colori[bus] [...] repræsentaret, quoad ve[ritatem] [...]in manus fragmentum E-

page.notes: The scan is cropped on the left, so many line beginnings and endings are missing or illegible; bracketed fragments mark words I could not read with certainty. Reconstructed bracketed words are not reliable. The heading and the opening word of the text are partly cut off. The catchword "pistolæ" and the signature "A 2" are printed at the foot. No page number is visible. A dark rule runs across the top of the page above the heading.
